speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Don't remind me! Oh, man. All soaped up and no place to go.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: How ya doin', buddy?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I was humiliated on national radio. How do you think I'm doing?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Come on, it wasn't that bad.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: What do you want?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: We represent the Lollipop Guild, and we want you.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, so Kripke played a joke on you.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: It wasn't funny.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I thought it was funny.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Raj.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You laughed.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Did you laugh?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I fell on the floor. All right, he got you, you can get him back.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I refuse to sink to his level.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You can't sink. With all that helium in you, you're lucky you don't float away.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Are you really admitting defeat?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I never admit defeat. However, on an unrelated topic, I am never getting out of this bed again.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Good.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What if you could make Kripke look even sillier than he made you look? You're not helping.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I don't think that's possible, dude. I didn't come to help, I came to mock.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, what you need to do is figure out a way to exact vengeance on Kripke, like, uh, like, how the Joker got back at Batman for putting him in the Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: That's true. He didn't just stay there and talk about his feelings with the other psychotic villains. He, he broke out and poisoned Gotham's water supply.
